M5.5 fixture provenance (speech + music coverage expansion)
=============================================================
All conversions by ffmpeg; no normalization; trims exact.

MUSIC
-----
Title:    Thoughtness (a simple GarageBand song, per file description)
Creator:  Kian Moretz (file page Artist credit; uploaded by Commons user Meecoder, own work)
Source:   https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Thoughtness.ogg
License:  CC0 1.0 Universal (file page UsageTerms: "Creative Commons Zero,
          Public Domain Dedication"; LicenseUrl:
          http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en)
Original: Thoughtness.ogg, 1148202 bytes,
          SHA-1 eeb6576c9f1ec1667dabca85bb7a5dc385c773b1 (matches Commons),
          Ogg Vorbis, stereo, 44100 Hz, 46.132245 s.
Passage:  9.0-19.0 s (10.0 s): continuous music with a ~0.7 s break at
          ~16.2 s and re-entry transient (sustained + transient coverage).
          Verified via silencedetect (-30 dB: pauses at 7.2/8.2/16.2/23.2 s,
          trailing silence from 40.9 s) and per-second RMS (~-26..-30 dB
          across 9-19 s).
Command:  ffmpeg -hide_banner -v error -y -ss 9 -t 10 \
            -i Thoughtness.ogg -ar 48000 -ac 2 -sample_fmt s16 \
            m7-music-stereo-48k.wav
Output:   m7-music-stereo-48k.wav, PCM s16le, stereo, 48000 Hz, 10.0 s
          (480000 samples/ch).
          SHA-256 b49e10a1d3f51b80db1d4d1a1179afa9963570528042395df20be8e2193f3086
C ref:    bin/aac-enc m7-music-stereo-48k.wav m55/aac/m7-music-stereo-48k.aac
          251279 bytes,
          SHA-256 791a948096c3ee4afc67fc77bae3f3f0db14839cb77bcc567569d1d618556fbb
          (ffprobe AAC-LC/48k/stereo, full FFmpeg decode exit 0).

Conversion (each passage; source mono duplicated to stereo, no norm.):
     ffmpeg -hide_banner -v error -y -ss <START> -t 10 -i <FLAC> \
       -ar 48000 -ac 2 -sample_fmt s16 m7-speech-<KIND>-stereo-48k.wav
